data.title: Cantor's $112,000 Bitcoin Call Lifts Strategy Target to $208
data.description: Cantor Fitzgerald raised its price target on Strategy NASDAQ:MSTR from $186 to $208 and kept an Overweight rating. The firm lifted its 12-month forward bitcoin price assumption to $112,000 from $98,000, taking a more bullish view on the asset after recent market strength. Strategy shares were down…
